To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the performance of a model depends on the characteristics of a dataset; (ii) a joint TF+TF model is more robust than either a MF model or a TF model alone; and (iii) the performance of the joint model depends on the number of entities and entity pairs in the dataset.

(1) there is no single TF or MF model that is robustly the best across all datasets, (2) there is a joint model that performs robust across all datasets, and (3) the performance of MF models can be improved by extending the models to handle OOV entity pairs.
